bind.description: Host and port (e.g., '0.0.0.0:8000') or Unix socket path (e.g., 'unix:/run/gunicorn.sock') to bind to.

workers.description: Number of worker processes. Typically set to 2–4 × number of CPU cores.

worker_class.description: Type of worker class to use. Common options: 'sync' (default), 'gevent', 'tornado', or async worker classes like 'uvicorn.workers.UvicornWorker'.

worker_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous clients per worker (only applicable for async worker classes).

timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds. If a request takes longer, the worker is restarted.

graceful_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for workers to finish handling current requests before force-killing them during reloads or restarts.

accesslog.description: Path to access log file. Use '-' to log to stdout, or a path like '/var/log/gunicorn/access.log'.

errorlog.description: Path to error log file. Use '-' to log to stderr, or a path like '/var/log/gunicorn/error.log'.

daemon.description: If true, run Gunicorn as a background (daemon) process.

proc_name.description: Process name to use in process listings and logs.

pidfile.description: Path to file where the main process ID (PID) will be written.

user.description: Unix username to drop privileges to after binding to port (requires root to bind to privileged ports).

group.description: Unix group name to drop privileges to after binding to port.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS for HTTPS. Requires keyfile and certfile paths below.

ssl_keyfile.description: Path to SSL private key file (e.g., '/etc/ssl/private/server.key'). Required if ssl_enabled=true.

ssl_certfile.description: Path to SSL certificate file (e.g., '/etc/ssl/certs/server.crt'). Required if ssl_enabled=true.

preload_app.description: If true, load the application code before forking worker processes (improves memory efficiency with copy-on-write).

reload.description: If true, automatically reload workers when source code changes (useful for development only).

max_requests.description: Restart workers after this many requests (helps prevent memory leaks). Use 0 to disable.

max_requests_jitter.description: Randomize restart jitter (± this many requests) to avoid thundering herd.

backlog.description: Maximum number of pending connections in the socket listen queue.

keepalive.description: Time (in seconds) to keep idle connections open for reuse.

extra_config.description: Additional Gunicorn configuration options as key-value pairs (for advanced or future compatibility).
